title: Creature
description: Defines a non-sentient or semi-sentient creature with comprehensive narrative integration, LLM-GM guidance, and enhanced progression systems.

name.description: The display name of the creature.

era.description: The primary era this creature is most associated with, e.g., 'Galactic_Republic', 'Galactic_Empire', 'New_Republic'.

rarity.description: How common or unique this creature is in the galaxy.

tags.description: UNIVERSAL TAGGING SYSTEM (Genesis Protocol Article II): Static tags that define this creature's characteristics, habitat, and behavior. All tags must be defined in master_tags.yml. Examples: ['beast', 'predator', 'nocturnal', 'kashyyyk_native'].

narrative.description: Rich narrative description of the creature, its role, and significance. Used by LLM-GM for storytelling.

flavor_text.description: Iconic quote or description that captures the essence of this creature, often from Star Wars lore.

cultural_significance.description: Description of how this creature is viewed by different cultures and groups in the galaxy.

description.description: Detailed mechanical and lore description of the creature.

origin_story.description: The history and origin of this creature in the galaxy.

habitat.description: Environments where this creature is typically found

narrative_tags.description: Tags for LLM storytelling and content generation

ai_behavior.description: A directive for the LLM GM on the creature's instinctual behavior and tactics

connections.description: Universal connections to any game object - factions, species, classes, locations, etc.

target_id.description: ID of the target object (faction, species, class, location, etc.).

target_type.description: The type of object being connected to.

relationship.description: The nature of the relationship, e.g., 'Found In', 'Hunted By', 'Allied With', 'From'.

narrative.description: Description of how these objects are connected.

mechanical_benefit.description: Optional mechanical benefit from this connection.

iconic_examples.description: Famous or notable examples of this creature type from Star Wars canon.

famous_creatures.description: Notable creatures of this type from Star Wars lore.

homeworld.description: The primary homeworld or origin of this creature.

cultural_notes.description: Important cultural information about this creature.

roleplay_guidance.description: Guidance for roleplaying encounters with this creature.

narrative_hooks.description: Story hooks and narrative elements specific to this creature.

social_dynamics.description: How this creature interacts with others in the galaxy.

common_motivations.description: Common motivations and behaviors for this creature.

creature_development.description: Guidance for creature development and progression.

base_prompt.description: Base prompt for generating images of this creature.

contextual_modifiers.description: Modifiers for different contexts and situations.

target_type.description: The type of image being generated (e.g., 'Portrait', 'Action_Shot', 'Habitat_Scene').

modifier_text.description: Additional text to add to the prompt for this context.

image.description: Path to the creature image file.

icon.description: Path to the creature icon file.

color.description: Primary color associated with this creature for UI theming.
